features.notes:
M1.2a DONE 2026-09-28. All five gates green; actual_loc 666 (tools/extract.py 221 + tools/test_extract.py 325 + download_stars.sh 120; fixtures excluded). 
TASK-1 EVIDENCE (reproduced the planner's 2026-09-28 values byte-for-byte, so no stop was needed): A19 ReadMe GET 200 / 10530 B sha256 425176a492a28c2da2d72cf9c56c002c7afb69c98dcc29761ee053cab1fa45bb; A6 ReadMe 200 / 39878 B sha256 a6ed8e561bd6903f9f29b3fe1a9b375b69202d6d55adfcdf2ad74a93c3fbb3ee; A19 file summary 'cns5.dat Lrecl 761 Records 5909' and cns5.dat 4502658 B = 5909 x 762 sha256 7e8c1a2ce4a2afcd70cdf40340c9685b1ec90e8e5085a81812dfa98c5c8adbbf; A6 file summary 'table1c.dat Lrecl 760 Records 331312' and table1c.dat.gz 75193892 B sha256 299f7c15025780df96d5f73fc299e89c81b76fe3de2231981d92ffde11f20ab1, gunzipped table1c.dat 252128432 B = 331312 x 761; legacy Gaia Sky URL curl -sI -> HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found (host deleted from the script); both .dat files LF-only (0 CR bytes) with every line exactly Lrecl bytes (761 / 760).
COLUMN SLICES: verified byte-by-byte against both ReadMes; all 11 slices the plan gives are correct (cns5 id 28-46, ra 55-74, dec 76-98, epoch 100-108, plx 130-148, G 362-371, BP 395-404, RP 428-437; gcns id 3-21, ra 23-36, dec 46-59, plx 69-77, G 123-130, BP 142-149, RP 161-168, WDprob 246-250, x50/y50/z50 304-315 / 343-354 / 382-393). No slice needed fixing.
GATE 1: 'python3 tools/extract.py cns5' -> 'parsed 5908 rows, skipped 1 rows (input 5909)'; 'gcns' -> 'parsed 331312 rows, skipped 0 rows (input 331312)'; exit 0. The single CNS5 skip is the placeholder row 5909 (CNS5=0, blank RA/Dec/plx). GATE 2: python3 tools/test_extract.py -> 15 tests OK (no pytest). GATE 3: SHA256SUMS carries 4 artifacts. GATE 4: grep for the legacy host prints NONE; cdsarc count 3. GATE 5: make test AILANG=$PWD/runtime/bin/ailang exit 0 (27 physics passed / 0 failed, 2 sim files checked, sim bridge 0 failures, parity identical 601 lines, strict VM == interpreter == closed form).
MUTATIONS: 16 applied to tools/extract.py, all killed, file restored byte-identically (sha256 99a1ff765c5d4d2726b9f5796e61834be0a2713a87fa07dc63b1d9e72b95b9a2 before and after). row1 pc->ly factor dropped -> test_alpha_cen_distance (+ test_gcns_xyz_crosscheck, plx guard); row1 sign flip in a rotation-matrix row -> test_alpha_cen_direction (+ crosscheck) [TABLE CORRECTION: a distance is rotation-invariant, so the sign flip is NOT killed by the distance test as the table implies; the direction test kills it]; row2 x<->y axis permutation -> test_alpha_cen_direction; row2 degrees-vs-radians -> test_alpha_cen_direction; row3 use -A -> test_gcns_xyz_crosscheck; row3 x1000 mas->arcsec slip -> test_gcns_xyz_crosscheck; row4 '>' read as '>=' -> test_gcns_wd_flag; row4 WDprob slice +1 byte -> test_gcns_wd_flag; row4 WDprob slice -1 byte -> test_gcns_wd_flag; row5 missing BPRP defaulted 0.0 -> test_missing_phot_cns5; row6 only one side of the BP/RP pair checked -> test_bprp_needs_both; row7 plx<=0 allowed -> test_distance_ly_from_parallax_guard; row7 plx guard removed (ZeroDivisionError) -> the same; row8 body column order reordered -> test_csv_schema; row8 id through float64 (unguarded) and (numeric ids only) -> test_csv_schema + test_gcns_csv_schema.
FINDING (surviving mutation, fixed): the plan's WDprob 'slice off by one byte' SURVIVED the original test. A 5-byte F5.3 field masks the shift: a +1 shift drops the leading digit so '1.000' reads 0.0 (only 1.000 rows expose it) and a -1 shift keeps two decimals so '0.506' reads 0.50 (only 0.501..0.509 rows expose it). The plan's 0.924 fixture kills neither direction. Fixed by adding two awk-cut fixtures (gcns_wd_1p000.dat WDprob 1.000, gcns_wdprob_0506.dat WDprob 0.506) plus the 0.500 boundary row; both directions are now killed. test_csv_schema/test_gcns_csv_schema were also strengthened to compare every id verbatim (19 of the 39 fixture ids do not survive a float64 round-trip; the first row's id happens to be exact) and to check the body column order, since the header check alone did not catch a body reorder.
DEVIATIONS (all measured): (1) alpha Cen: CNS5 has exactly one GJ 559 row (line 5103) and it is the AB system (Comp=AB) - there is no separate 'component suffix A' row. Its plx 754.81 mas gives 4.3210 ly, not the plan's 4.370 +- 0.02 ly (4.370 is the popular literature figure; the plan's own direction expectation l=315.7, b=-0.68 is satisfied by exactly this row, so the row choice is right). test_alpha_cen_distance asserts 4.3210 +- 0.02. (2) Fixtures added beyond the plan's list, all real bytes cut with sed/awk from data/raw: cns5_bp_blank_rp_set.dat (the one-sided-pair mutation), cns5_null_plx.dat (blank plx, the only such row in CNS5), gcns_wd_1p000.dat and gcns_wdprob_0506.dat (see FINDING); 10 fixtures, 37 KB, LF-only, exact commands recorded in the test_extract.py docstring. (3) CNS5 id fallback: the ReadMe's '-' missing marker is treated as missing as well as blank (672 rows have no GaiaDR3 id, and the fallback id is 'CNS5:<designation>'). The plan only said 'if blank'. (4) download_stars.sh writes data/raw/.gdignore: without it `make import` (part of `make test`) makes Godot import the 24 MB gcns.csv as a CSV *translation* source and emit ~70 MB of *.translation + *.csv.import sidecars into data/raw (measured). (5) .gitignore gains __pycache__/ and *.pyc - Python is now part of the toolchain. (6) A row with missing RA or Dec is counted as skipped as well as blank/<=0 plx; only the single placeholder row hits any of these, so the counts above are unaffected. (7) download_stars.sh is idempotent for SHA256SUMS (re-running a tier replaces its lines rather than appending).
